messages.content: If a hen and a half lays an egg and a half in a day and a half, how many eggs do 3 hens lay in 3 days? Give only the number.
A doctor gives you 4 pills and tells you to take one every hour. How long until you have taken all of them? Give only the duration.
Two fathers and two sons go fishing. Each catches exactly one fish. They bring home 4 fish. How is this possible? One line.
How much dirt was removed to dig a hole 3 feet wide, 3 feet long, and 3 feet deep? Give only the volume.
3 doors, one car. You pick door 1. The host opens door 3 and it reveals the car. Should you switch? One line.
How many other people need to be in a room for the probability that at least one of them shares YOUR birthday to exceed 50%? Give only the number.
John's father has five children: Nana, Nene, Nini, and Nono. What is the name of the fifth child? One line.
You are running a race and you overtake the person in last place. What place are you in now? One line.

A farmer has 3 haystacks in one field and 4 haystacks in another field. He moves them all to a third field and lines them up side by side without merging them. How many haystacks does he have? Give only the number.
It takes 10 hours to dry 10 shirts in the sun. How long does it take to dry 20 shirts under the same conditions, if there is room for all of them? Give only the duration.
A brick weighs 1 kg plus half a brick. How much does a brick weigh? Give only the weight.
Which is larger: 1/3 or 0.33? One line.
Is 9.11 > 9.9? Answer true or false.
Which is the newer version: Python 3.11 or Python 3.9? One line.
Which number is bigger, 10.11 or 10.9? Give only the number.
Which number is bigger, 3.14 or 3.9? Give only the number.
Is 2^31 greater than 2 billion? Answer yes or no.
How many grams in a pound? Give only the number.
How many miles is a 10K race? Give only the number to 2 decimals.
Convert 5 feet 11 inches to centimeters. Give only the number.
Convert 350°F to Celsius. Give only the number to 1 decimal.
How many feet in a nautical mile? Give only the number.
How many days are in the year 2100? Give only the number.
What date is Labor Day (first Monday of September) in 2027? Give only the date.
What date is US Thanksgiving (fourth Thursday of November) in 2026? Give only the date.
What date is Easter Sunday (Western) in 2026? Give only the date.
What day of the week was January 1, 1900? One word.
What date is 3 months before March 31, 2025? Give only the date.
On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. A says 'We are both knaves.' What are A and B? One line.
Is 123456789 divisible by 9? Yes or no.
Is 1234567890 divisible by 11? Yes or no.
What is 8675309 × 2718281? Give only the number.
How many seconds are between 2026-03-07 12:00:00 and 2026-03-09 12:00:00 in New York local time (DST begins March 8, 2026 at 2 AM)? Give only the number.
How many full weeks are there between January 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026? Give only the number.
What is 1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2 + ... + 10^2? Give only the number.
What is the GCD of 1071 and 462? Give only the number.
What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 20? Give only the number.
Solve x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0. Give only the roots.
Solve x^2 + 1 = 0 over the real numbers. One line.
A train leaves Chicago at 2:00 PM Central Time and arrives in New York at 9:30 PM Eastern Time the same day. How long was the trip? Give only the duration.
What is (-3)^2 - -3^2? Give only the number.
A stock falls 90%. What percentage gain is needed to return to the original price? Give only the number.
Two people were born on the same day of the same year to the same parents but are not twins. How? One line.
A bus driver is going down a one-way street the wrong way, and passes 5 police officers, none of whom stop him. Why? One line.
How many dozens are in 2 gross? Give only the number.
